page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 32 dedicated AMD EPYC vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The platform is paired with 128.0 GB of total system RAM, corresponding to 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes 8 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, operates without hardware graphics accelerators, and offers zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware configuration adheres to a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio typical of general-purpose cloud profiles. Local storage is omitted entirely, meaning the instance relies on remote network block storage volumes for system and data persistence. Dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the 32 cores do not contend for host processor cycles with neighbor instances, offering steady execution capacity across varied application states.

This instance profile fits workloads that require balanced processing throughput and memory footprints without needing specialized hardware acceleration or local high-IOPS NVMe drives. Representative use cases include multi-tier web applications, backend enterprise services, container cluster worker nodes, distributed ETL batch processing, and relational or caching database servers backed by external block storage volumes.
